text:
amanda: Heads-up: my docs PR (#4321) is blocked. The SDK snippet for Private deployment shows using REDWOOD_API_KEY env var and suggests rotating keys via rolling restart — but runtime behavior seems different. Anyone from eng-runtime able to confirm? :thinking:
ryan: Which snippet exactly? can you paste the lines so we can be precise?
amanda: sure — snippet in the PR currently:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... # example
redwood start --private
```
It reads like the runtime will pick up new env values on restart/signal, but my reviewer said Private ignores env updates until full redeploy.
marco: That matches what I remember. Private control-plane stores credentials in KMS and the agent reads them on startup only. We should avoid implying hot-reload.
sahil: I'm the docs reviewer. Is this a hard blocker for merge? CI preview passed but I don't want us to ship misleading instructions.
amanda: yes, reviewer held merge. Need explicit confirmation of behavior and exact config names so docs can say the correct workflow (control plane rotation vs restart vs hot reload).
ryan: cc @maria-runtime for confirmation. @maria-runtime can you weigh in?
maria-runtime: Confirming behavior: Private agent does NOT pick up changes to REDWOOD_API_KEY from the environment at runtime. Current behavior: agent reads keys at process start; key rotation requires control-plane rotation or a process restart unless kms_auto_refresh is enabled.
marco: Nice — can you state the default for kms_auto_refresh?
maria-runtime: Default is false. When enabled, the agent polls KMS every 24h (config key: private.config.kms_auto_refresh). There is also a follow-up engineering task to add a webhook-based reload, but that's not yet shipped.
sahil: Great — please paste that exact phrasing so I can update the docs PR. Also linking to the config reference is helpful.
amanda: Using that wording now. I'll change the SDK snippet to show control-plane rotation flow and add a short note in the migration guide about restart requirements.
sahil: After that update I'll re-run linkcheck and merge if CI preview still green.
amanda: Thanks everyone — marking as ready-for-merge once the wording and snippet are updated. :white_check_mark:
doc-bot: CI preview created: https://preview.docs.redwood/PR-4321 :rocket:
